title: Menopause
summary: What is menopause?Menopause is the time in your life when you stop having your period and can no longer get pregnant. You have reached menopause when you have not had a period for 12 months.The time leading up to menopause is called the menopausal transition, or perimenopause. This transition usually begins when you are in your 40s, but sometimes it can start earlier. It can last for several years. The most common age for reaching menopause is between 45 and 55 years old. What is early and premature menopause?Early and premature menopause happens when your ovaries stop making hormones and your periods stop at a younger age than usual. When menopause happens before age 40, it's called premature menopause. If menopause happens before age 45, it's called early menopause.This can happen on its own (with no known cause). It can also happen because of surgery to remove the ovaries. Surgery to remove the uterus alone will cause your periods to stop, but it does not cause menopause unless the ovaries are also removed.
